title: Fix the Skipped Name Input
description: The program should read an age and then a full name, printing both.
expectedBehavior: The program should read the age, then read the full name typed on the next line, and print both together.
actualProblem: nextInt() reads the number but leaves the trailing newline character in the input buffer. The very next nextLine() call then immediately consumes that leftover newline instead of waiting for the user's name, producing an empty name.
expectedOutput: Enter age: Enter full name: 30 - Asha Verma
explanation: Scanner.nextInt() only consumes the digits, not the newline character that follows them when the user presses Enter. Adding a throwaway scanner.nextLine() call consumes that leftover newline before reading the actual next line of text.
